caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 12.1 of the Security Policy and operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: A software library that contains cryptographic functionality to serve BoringSSL and other user-space applications.

Ubuntu Linux 15.04 running on POWER8 without PAA (clang Compiler Version 4.0.0)
Ubuntu Linux 16.04 running on Intel Xeon E5 with PAA (clang Compiler Version 4.0.0)
Ubuntu Linux 17.04 running on POWER8 with PAA (clang Compiler Version 4.0.0)
Ubuntu Linux 17.04 running on POWER9 with PAA (clang Compiler Version 4.0.0) (single-user mode)
